description: Generic escape hatch for any of the ~100 Energi Data Service (Energinet, Denmark) datasets. Examples: "ProductionConsumptionSettlement" (production/consumption by type per area+hour), "CO2EmisProg" (CO2 prognosis), "DayAheadPrices", "CO2Emis". Returns the raw records array for the dataset. Keyless official open data.

filter.description: Column→value[] filter, e.g. {"PriceArea":["DK1"]}. Values are arrays.

name: query_dataset
